description: A shell script for testing Git submodule behavior with sparse checkout scenarios, focusing on reading and writing .gitmodules when not in the working tree.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a path is missing.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Runs a test tool with specified arguments.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or timestamp.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after test completion.
